title: Final Energy Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct energy of the neutron as E = 1.9 x 10^11 MeV.

title: Final Mass Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct rest mass of the pi meson as m_pi = 139.4 MeV.

title: Use of Lorentz Factor
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply the Lorentz factor gamma in their calculations.

title: Momentum Conservation
description: Important Criteria: The student must demonstrate understanding of momentum conservation in the decay process.

title: Kinetic Energy Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly calculate the total energy of the muon including its kinetic energy.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Limiting Cases
description: Optional Criteria: The student may discuss limiting cases or assumptions made during the calculations.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common sign mistakes in energy and momentum calculations.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should not omit any necessary factors in the equations used.
